title: Hummingbirds Can't Walk
description: Hummingbirds are amazing fliers, but their tiny feet cannot walk or hop.

scenes.text: Hummingbirds are some of the best fliers on the planet. But they cannot walk.
scenes.subject: hummingbird
scenes.say: Hummingbirds are some of the best fliers on the planet. [chuckles] But they cannot walk.

scenes.text: Their feet are tiny and weak. They can grip a branch and shuffle sideways, but they cannot walk or even hop.
scenes.subject: hummingbird
scenes.say: [sighs] Their feet are tiny and weak. They can grip a branch and shuffle sideways, but they cannot walk or even hop.

scenes.text: So to move even a few inches, a hummingbird has to fly. Its wings can beat around fifty times every second.
scenes.subject: hummingbird
scenes.say: So to move even a few inches, a hummingbird has to fly. [excited] Its wings can beat around FIFTY times every second.

scenes.text: They are also among the only birds that can fly backwards, and they can hover in one spot like a tiny helicopter.
scenes.subject: hummingbird
scenes.say: They are also among the only birds that can fly backwards, and they can hover in one spot like a tiny helicopter.

scenes.text: Built to fly, not to walk. Follow for more weird facts.
scenes.subject: hummingbird
scenes.say: [laughs] Built to fly, not to walk. Follow for more weird facts.
